user.title: Away Assistant
user.description: Everything is optional and can be changed later.

basics.name: Basics
basics.description: Who gets told, who lives here, and when the daily report goes out.

data_description.notify_services: Every message goes to all of these (for example notify.mobile_app_your_phone).
data_description.persons: A phone arriving home during Coming home switches to Home after 10 min; during Away it only asks.
data_description.daily_report_time: While away, a 'house is fine' message at this time every day.
data_description.lights_off_when_leaving: Every light that is on (not light groups) is turned off on Away.

heating.name: Heating and warm-up
heating.description: Thermostats are turned down on Away and put back for the warm-up.

data.time_constant_guess: Starting guess: how slowly the house cools
data.heating_rate_guess: Starting guess: how fast the heating warms it

data_description.thermostats: Set to the away temperature on Away (never above their own setpoint), put back at warm-up.
data_description.temperature_sensors: For the coldest/warmest room and the house model. Empty: the thermostats' own readings.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Used by the calculated warm-up and the reports.
data_description.weather: Its hourly forecast gives the outdoor temperature during the warm-up.
data_description.warm_up_min_hours: A calculated warm-up never starts later than this before the return. The longest is the Warm-up hours setting on the device.
data_description.warm_up_margin_hours: Added to what the model says the warm-up needs.
data_description.time_constant_guess: Hours (the house's time constant). Measured while you're away and learned trip by trip; this is only the start. Floor heating: about 100.
data_description.heating_rate_guess: K per hour with everything calling, before losses. Measured during each warm-up. Floor heating: about 0.2.
data_description.on_track_hours: Hours before the return (at most halfway through the warm-up) when every room is checked against its setpoint.
data_description.on_track_tolerance: A room this close to its setpoint counts as on track.

while_away.name: While away
while_away.description: Other things to change while you're away. Everything is put back.

data.covers: Covers to close and keep closed

data_description.preset_climates: For example a ventilation unit. Put back at warm-up.
data_description.switches_off: Switches, automations, input booleans or fans turned off while away and put back on Home.
data_description.select_option: The option every chosen select is set to while away.
data_description.covers: Closed on Away; if one opens it is closed again (up to 3 times a day) and you're told.

alerts.name: Alerts
alerts.description: Only while Away or Coming home.

data.report_extras: Extra lines in the daily report

data_description.vacuum: Motion alerts are ignored while it's out (at most 90 min) and shortly after it docks. Doors are never ignored.
data_description.fault_sensors: Problem binary sensors, for example a heat pump's fault output. Alert after 5 min.
data_description.backup_heater_energy: An energy counter (kWh). A rise of 0.3 kWh or more while away is an urgent alert, at most hourly.
data_description.power_sensor: A UPS status sensor (on battery when it reports OB or LB) or a binary sensor that is off during a power cut.
data_description.connectivity_sensors: For example a Zigbee bridge. Alert after 15 min off.
data_description.appliances: Flagged in the pre-flight check if mid-cycle.
data_description.battery_ignore: Left out of the pre-flight low-battery check (phones are left out by themselves).

lived_in.name: Lived-in lights
lived_in.description: Replays what these did N days ago. Set Lived-in lights on the device to Preview first to check it.

data.replay_days: Replay from this many days ago

data_description.replay_entities: Only choose switches that are safe to switch on unattended (no heaters or kettles).
data_description.replay_days: The recorder must keep more days than this (its default is 10).
data_description.replay_shift_minutes: Up to this many minutes earlier or later, a new shift each day at 04:00.
data_description.skip_label: Label an area to switch its lights out of the replay.

error.unknown_notify: One of the notify services doesn't exist.
error.select_option_missing: Choose the option the selects are set to while away.
error.preset_missing: Choose the preset to use while away.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Away Assistant is already set up.
